programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: There are still places where education remains a luxury that many children can only dream of.These include Bangladesh - a small country in South Asia, one of the most densely populated and poorest in the world.An area twice as large as Poland is inhabited by as many as 170 million people.At the same time, 20% of the population lives below the poverty line.Obtaining an education gives you a chance to improve your financial situation.Unfortunately, the monsoons that hit Bangladesh every year cut off 1/4 of its area from the rest of the world, including schools.To help thousands of children, squares, libraries and educational centers were created... on boats.He studies there, among others:Rabija, the youngest heroine of Martyna Wojciechowska's program so far.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: This time, Martyna Wojciechowska moves not only in space, but also in time.He goes to a place that is only thirty kilometers from Santa Cruz - one of the largest, most populated cities in Bolivia.The traveler visits Mennonites living in harsh and wild rural communities.They consciously reject electricity and modern technology.They devote themselves to religion, farming and animal husbandry.They don't do any sports, they don't have access to TV or phones because all of this is prohibited.Their education ends with basic knowledge of arithmetic and the study of the Bible.Viewers will see how Martyna Wojciechowska finds herself in this extraordinary world.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits an extraordinary beauty salon located in Lahore, Pakistan.His services are used by women who have suffered acid burns in the past.Dousing and arson attacks affect up to several thousand women every year.A bottle of acid does not cost even a zloty, the substance is easily available, and the attack lasts a few seconds.The traveler talks to Musarrat Misbah, who has already helped over five hundred injured women.It provides victims with proper medical care, reconstructive surgery, psychological care and employment.He gives them jobs in his salon.Viewers will see what the life of the so-calledfaceless women.
